methods.B3: same-seed main BC actor initialization then PPO

exposure_policy.rejected_candidate: initial HV>=10 in every case is not met: 8/30 baseline pilot cases below10; do not claim pass

bc.dataset_loader_status: KC05 implemented; main pool not collected

rewards.progress: max(0,current_progress-last_progress)/10; arrival sets progress to route length
rewards.invalid_request: -0.02 once per control interval with known rejection reasons
rewards.lane_change: -0.01 once per interval with actual lane change execution
rewards.note: Unsupported causal unjustified-wait classifier stays disabled. No tuning to improve one method; failure and elapsed time still reported.

case_generation.training: train namespace; case cursor0 onward; same order for B2/B3 and no policy RNG in traffic seeds. Different episode lengths mean unequal realized case counts at equal transitions.
case_generation.expert: Before collection, scenario-local ordinal j assigns val iff j%5==4, train otherwise. Use expert_val/expert_train namespace respectively and case_index=j. Group never crosses split; report actual transition split.
case_generation.bc_views: After successful whole-episode filter, freeze 200k train/50k val unique-row views without replacement using view RNG20261115; common views for all3seeds; insufficient successful rows blocks BC.
case_generation.archive: archive namespace case cursor0 onward; six fixed budget-end models; no updates.
case_generation.final: Generated once; sealed until main policies fixed. Never use final for model/config selection.

metrics.primary: Supported-rule compliant completion: correct goal/route within300s, no AV collision, no classified red entry.
metrics.target_time: First checkpoint of two consecutive complete, valid dev100 evaluations >=0.80. Record confirmation checkpoint separately. If no confirmation by1M, right-censored.
metrics.signal_unknown: Any unknown classification invalidates supported compliant aggregate; preserve raw completion and unknown counts. No silent exclusion.
metrics.failures: Policy deadline/collision/removal/etc remain in valid denominator; infrastructure attempts stored separately; incomplete dev100 cannot confirm target.
metrics.time: Report completion time conditional on success plus failure-penalized time300s and standstill/LC failure; never rank only successful episodes.
metrics.uncertainty: Three independent learner seeds; same case panel paired within seed; report seed results and variation, avoid treating episodes as independent learner replicates.

model_selection.BC: Minimum held-out validation MSE+CE at updates500..10000; earliest on exact tie. Train critic/log_std disabled.
model_selection.B1_B3: Exactly same selected main-BC actor for each seed; B3 fresh PPO optimizer and matched fresh critic head/log_std; shared trunk pretraining is part of treatment.
model_selection.B2: Fresh weights/optimizer per seed; no pilot initialization.
model_selection.PPO_final: Budget-end1M primary; dev-best secondary only, no final-driven reselection.
model_selection.save: Post-update at50k boundaries and safe STOP; preserve counters/optimizer/RNG/rollout/environment current-episode replay. GPU long-history resume still requires operational validation.
